extraction_notes: Main-text performance figures digitised: Figure 1a–c and Figure 6. Figure 5a is an Arrhenius plot and was skipped according to the instruction to skip Arrhenius plots. Numerical values are approximate readings from marker centers or bar tops; all plotted values use qualifier '~'.
